title: A Visitor for the Cellar
author: Astrid Nystrom
blurb: Rafael Thornbury, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
